---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv")
attacks
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
    Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown/other"
  )) |>
  count(outcome, name = "attacks")
```
